legacy_root.title: Execution policy for plugin-shipped scripts
legacy_root.question_or_target: Define and enforce what a shipped plugin script may do: which executables it may spawn, whether it may reach the network, which directories it may write, and what happens when it exceeds the policy.
legacy_root.windows_limitation: Windows has no native OS-level process sandbox; IMP-0064 uses a userspace intercept that refuses disallowed spawn, write, and network and records FORBIDDEN_* codes. It is not a kernel jail.

does_not_cover: ctypes/native syscalls in the same interpreter
operations performed by an already-allowlisted native child
Windows kernel sandbox / AppContainer / Job-Object isolation

owner_signoff.note: This unit ships fail-closed refuse-and-record machinery and a deny-by-default policy shape. Widening allowed_executables, write roots, or network endpoints is an owner action; this delivery does not grant extra rights.

legacy_root.notes: G-1 for IMP-0064: userspace intercept enforces spawn/write/network allowlists, records violations, and states the Windows OS-sandbox limitation inline. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write.
